_comment: Naming convention: <surface>_<element>_<role>. Surface = where the string appears (account_setup, settings, compose, …). Element = which UI thing inside that surface. Role = label / placeholder / hint / error / button / etc. Keep keys snake_case so they look good in autocomplete and don't fight ESLint identifier rules. Add new keys when you touch a string; the codebase is migrated lazily — see CLAUDE.md → i18n.
settings_general_language_hint: Change which language Unkai Mail uses for its UI. The new language takes effect after the next restart.
settings_general_language_auto_hint: Use the language reported by your operating system. Turn off to pin a specific language regardless of system setting.
settings_general_language_restart_body: The new language will be applied the next time Unkai Mail starts.
settings_general_file_assoc_hint: Unkai is registered with your operating system as a possible handler. Mark it as the default in your OS settings to have double-clicked calendar invites and email files open here.
settings_general_replay_tour_hint: Replay the quick feature tour from your first launch.
tour_welcome_body: Your account is ready. Take a quick look around — the tour takes less than a minute, and you can skip it at any time.
tour_mail_list_body: New mail lands here. Related messages are grouped into conversations, so a whole back-and-forth reads as one entry. Click any message to open it in the reading pane.
tour_triage_body: Hover over a message for quick actions: flag it, pin it to the top of the list, or mark it read. Right-click for more — priority, reminders, and moving to folders.
tour_search_body: Search the current folder or your whole account. Operators like from:, subject:, is:unread and before: narrow the results — hints appear as you type.
tour_compose_body: Start a new email here. Compose supports rich text, attachments from your computer or Nextcloud, signatures, and encryption.
tour_nextcloud_body: Contacts, Calendar, Files, Talk, Tasks and Notes appear on the left rail once a Nextcloud account is connected. Each icon opens the full view without leaving your mail.
tour_settings_body: Accounts, design, encryption, and Nextcloud connections all live in Settings. You can replay this tour from the General section at any time.
tour_done_body: Enjoy Unkai Mail. Your mail is syncing in the background and will appear in a moment.
settings_mail_conversation_view_hint: Bundle replies in the same thread under a single row with an expand chevron. Turn off to see every message as its own row in date order.
account_setup_welcome_subtitle: Let's set up your email account
account_setup_nextcloud_explainer: Connect a Nextcloud server to sync contacts and calendars, attach files from your cloud, and join Talk rooms. This step is optional — you can always connect later under Settings → Nextcloud.
account_setup_nextcloud_connected: Connected as {user} on {server}. Contacts and calendars are syncing in the background.
nextcloud_connect_error_empty_url: Please enter your Nextcloud server URL.
nextcloud_connect_error_parse_url: Could not parse the server URL.
nextcloud_connect_error_start_failed: Failed to start the Nextcloud login.
nextcloud_connect_cert_probe_failed: Could not retrieve the server certificate: {reason}
nextcloud_connect_cert_title: The server's TLS certificate isn't trusted by default.
nextcloud_connect_cert_explainer: This is normal for self-hosted Nextcloud servers using a self-signed certificate. Compare the fingerprint below with the certificate on your server before trusting.
nextcloud_connect_trusting_one: Trusting 1 self-signed certificate for this connection.
nextcloud_connect_trusting_many: Trusting {n} self-signed certificates for this connection.
nextcloud_connect_waiting: Waiting for authorisation in your browser…
account_setup_dav_explainer: Choose where your contacts and calendars live. If you connected a Nextcloud in the previous step they already sync from there — you can simply finish.
account_setup_dav_option_skip_hint: Use Nextcloud (if connected), or set this up later in Settings.
account_setup_dav_option_dav_hint: Sync contacts and calendars from a different server than your mail or Nextcloud account.
account_setup_dav_option_local_hint: Keep contacts and calendars in the local, encrypted store — no server involved.
account_setup_dav_validation_server: Please fill in the server URL, username and password.
account_setup_dav_validation_kinds: Enable at least contacts or calendars.
account_setup_dav_added_dav: Added {name} — contacts and calendars are syncing in the background.
account_setup_dav_cert_explainer: This is normal for self-hosted CardDAV/CalDAV servers using a self-signed certificate. Compare the fingerprint below with the certificate on your server before trusting.
nextcloud_settings_local_note: Contacts and calendars from this source are stored only on this device.
account_setup_account_name_hint: How this account is labelled inside Unkai.
account_setup_your_name_hint: Shown as the sender on outgoing mail. Defaults to the account name when empty.
account_setup_imap_explainer: IMAP is the protocol used to receive your emails. Port 993 uses TLS encryption (recommended).
account_setup_password_hint: Stored securely in your OS keychain — never written to disk in plain text.
account_setup_smtp_explainer: SMTP is the protocol used to send your emails. Port 587 uses STARTTLS encryption (recommended).
account_setup_jmap_hint: Modern push-based mail protocol. Only enable if your provider supports it.
account_setup_signature_hint: Appended to new messages sent from this account. You can change it later in Settings.
signature_popout_button_title: Edit signature in a separate window
signature_popout_button_aria: Open signature editor in a separate window
signature_popout_locked_banner: Editing in pop-out window — close that window to edit here again.
signature_popout_placeholder: Appended to new messages sent from this account.
signature_popout_missing_state: No popout state found for this signature editor window.
signature_popout_account_missing: The account this window was opened for is no longer configured.
account_setup_validation_step0: Please fill in the account name and email address.
account_setup_validation_step1: Please enter your IMAP server hostname and password.
account_setup_validation_step2: Please enter your SMTP server hostname.
account_setup_provider_hint: Pick your provider to fill in the server settings, or leave this on automatic detection.
account_setup_provider_hint_applied: Using the known server settings for {provider}. You can still change them in the next steps.
account_setup_provider_hint_app_password: {provider} does not accept your normal account password here — create an app password in your provider's security settings and use that instead.
account_setup_provider_hint_enable_remot: {provider} ships with IMAP access turned off — enable IMAP/POP3 access in your provider's mailbox settings first, or the connection test will fail.
account_setup_discovery_hint_fallback: Couldn't auto-discover {domain} — best-guess hostnames filled in. Edit if needed.
account_setup_cert_title: The server's TLS certificate isn't trusted by default.
account_setup_cert_explainer: This is normal for self-hosted mail servers using a self-signed certificate. Compare the fingerprint below with your server's actual certificate before trusting.
account_setup_cert_probe_failed: Could not retrieve the server certificate to display: {reason}
account_setup_cert_trusting_one: Trusting 1 self-signed certificate for this account.
account_setup_cert_trusting_many: Trusting {n} self-signed certificates for this account.
compose_attachment_warning_title: You mentioned an attachment but didn't attach a file.
compose_attachment_warning_body: Add a file before sending, or dismiss this warning if it's a false alarm.
compose_forward_attachments_body_one: The forwarded message has 1 attachment. Add it to your forward?
compose_forward_attachments_body_many: The forwarded message has {n} attachments. Add them to your forward?
compose_pgp_recipient_no_key_title: No PGP key for some recipients
compose_pgp_recipient_no_key_body: We don't have a public key on file for: {addresses}. The encrypted send will fail until you import a key or remove these recipients.
compose_crypto_encrypt_title_active: Encryption on — click to switch back to plaintext
compose_crypto_sign_title: Sign this message (body stays in cleartext)
compose_crypto_sign_title_active: Sign-only on — click to switch back to plaintext
compose_crypto_send_needs_passphrase: Open the Encryption tab and enter your passphrase to send
compose_read_receipt_title: Request a read receipt from the recipients — their mail client may decline or ignore the request
compose_read_receipt_title_active: A read receipt will be requested — click to turn off
compose_delivery_receipt_title: Ask the mail server to confirm delivery to each recipient's mailbox — only works when the server supports delivery status notifications
compose_delivery_receipt_title_active: A delivery confirmation will be requested — click to turn off
mail_view_mdn_banner: {sender} asked for a read receipt for this message.
mail_view_receipt_requested_title: You asked for a read receipt — no response yet. Recipients can decline the request, so one may never arrive.
settings_mail_mdn_hint: How to respond when a sender asks to be told that you displayed their message. Receipts reveal when you read mail, so nothing is sent without your say-so unless you pick Always.
mail_decrypt_for_reply_body: Enter your PGP passphrase to decrypt the message from {sender} so your reply can quote the original content.
mail_decrypt_for_forward_body: Enter your PGP passphrase to decrypt the message from {sender} so the forward carries the original content.
nc_share_expiration_aria: Pick expiration date for the share link
nc_share_expiration_hint: Recipients can't open the link after this date.
contact_form_placeholder_notes: Anything you want to remember about this contact
contact_view_empty_state: No contact details to show yet.
outbox_banner_empty: The Outbox is empty. Mail you send appears here briefly while it's on its way.
outbox_banner_failed: {count} messages couldn't be sent yet — Unkai will keep retrying on every sync. You can retry now, edit, or discard each one.
outbox_banner_failed_singular: 1 message couldn't be sent yet — Unkai will keep retrying on every sync. You can retry now, edit, or discard it.
outbox_banner_in_flight: {count} messages in flight. They'll move to Sent once the server confirms.
outbox_banner_in_flight_singular: 1 message in flight. It'll move to Sent once the server confirms.
outbox_button_retry_with_passphrase_titl: Re-supply your PGP passphrase and try sending this encrypted message again
outbox_button_edit_title: Re-open this message in Compose to edit it
outbox_passphrase_explain: This message is encrypted with your OpenPGP key. Enter your passphrase to unlock the key and retry the send.
outbox_view_unreadable: This queued message couldn't be parsed for preview.
event_editor_readonly_banner: This calendar is read-only — you can view this event, but changes can't be saved.
event_planner_no_attendees: Add at least one attendee to see availability.
event_planner_source_local_title: From your own calendars (this person isn't a Nextcloud user, or their calendar isn't shared with you).
settings_location_geocoding_help: Off by default. When on, the event editor's Location field offers geocoded suggestions with an inline map preview, and the contact form's Addresses section suggests matching street addresses as you type. Each typed query goes to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service and the event-editor map loads tiles from openstreetmap.org — both third-party services outside your Nextcloud.
settings_nominatim_base_url_hint: Leave empty to use the public OpenStreetMap Nominatim service. To route queries through your own self-hosted Nominatim instead, paste its base URL (e.g. https://nominatim.example.com).
settings_notes_mail_open_in_view_hint: When on, clicking a mail link inside a note flips the main view to the inbox at that message. When off (default), the message opens in a standalone reader window so the Notes view stays put.
mail_view_message_gone: This message no longer exists on the server.
sidebar_clear_spam_body: Permanently delete all messages in {folder}? They won't be moved to Trash, and this can't be undone.
sidebar_clear_spam_failed: Failed to clear the spam folder
sidebar_mark_all_read_failed: Failed to mark the folder as read
encryption_no_key_explanation: Import an OpenPGP private key to sign outgoing mail and decrypt incoming mail on this account. The armored key is stored in the OS keychain; the passphrase is not retained.
encryption_passphrase_hint: The passphrase is used once to verify the key parses, then dropped. Compose will prompt for it again on every encrypted send.
mail_view_cannot_decrypt_banner: This message is encrypted. The server didn't expose the raw bytes so it can't be decrypted here — open it via IMAP or a desktop PGP client.
mail_view_attachment_decrypt_required: Please re-enter your passphrase via the Decrypt button below to open this attachment.
mail_view_chip_signed_untrusted_tooltip: The signature is valid, but the signing certificate isn't issued by a trusted authority and isn't one you've saved.
mail_view_chip_signed_expired_tooltip: The signature is valid, but the signing certificate is outside its validity period.
mail_view_links_all_safe_detail: All {count} links in this message were checked against URLhaus — no known threats.
mail_view_links_all_safe_detail_one: The link in this message was checked against URLhaus — no known threats.
mail_view_link_unsafe_tooltip_domain: URLhaus has flagged other URLs on this domain — threat: {threat}
contact_form_placeholder_pgp_key: -----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK----- or -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
contact_form_hint_pgp_keys: Paste an ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key or an X.509 (S/MIME) certificate in PEM form. Round-trips through the contact's vCard and is also cached locally so Compose can encrypt to this address.
encryption_unlock_auto_hint_off: Off — Compose asks for your PGP passphrase on every encrypted send, and encrypted mail shows a Decrypt button you have to click.
encryption_unlock_auto_storage_hint: Stored in the OS keychain alongside this account's mail password. Removing the PGP key here clears it; toggling this off also clears it.
compose_pgp_auto_unlock_active: Auto-unlock is on — your saved passphrase will be used.
compose_smime_auto_unlock_active: Auto-unlock is on — your saved passphrase will be used.
smime_no_cert_explanation: Import an S/MIME certificate (.p12 / .pfx) to sign outgoing mail and decrypt incoming mail on this account. The bundle is stored in the OS keychain; the passphrase is not retained.
smime_passphrase_hint: The passphrase is used once to unlock the PKCS#12 bundle, then dropped. Compose will prompt for it again on every signed send.
smime_unlock_auto_hint_off: Off — Compose asks for your S/MIME passphrase on every signed send, and encrypted mail shows a Decrypt button you have to click.
smime_unlock_auto_storage_hint: Stored in the OS keychain alongside this account's mail password. Removing the S/MIME certificate here clears it; toggling this off also clears it.
search_tip_after: sent on or after a date
search_tip_in: only in that folder (in:anywhere for all)
search_help_intro: Click an operator to insert it into the search field. Operators can be combined with free text and with each other.
talk_view_no_matches: No Talk rooms match this search.
files_view_no_matches: No files in this folder match this search.
files_view_new_folder_title: Create a new folder in this directory
files_view_refresh_title: Reload this folder from the server
files_view_send_link_title: Open a new mail with public download links inserted into the body
files_view_send_attachment_title: Open a new mail with the selected files attached
files_view_send_attachment_folders_only_: Folders can be shared as a link, but not attached as bytes
calendar_view_sync_title: Sync calendars with the server now
talk_view_share_link_title: Open a new mail with this room's join link
talk_view_open_title: Open this Talk room in your browser
talk_view_delete_title: Delete this Talk room for everyone
shares_view_no_matches: No share links match this search.
shares_view_no_account_html: No Nextcloud account connected. Add one under Settings → Nextcloud first.
shares_view_pick_account_hint: Pick an account to view its share links.
shares_view_empty_html: No share links yet. Share files from Nextcloud Files or Compose's "Attach from Nextcloud" picker to mint your first link.
shares_view_open_title: Open this share in your browser
shares_view_revoke_confirm:
Revoke the share link for "{name}"?

The link will stop working for anyone who has it — there's no undo.
shares_edit_expiration_aria: Pick expiration date for the share link
shares_edit_expiration_hint: Recipients can't open the link after this date.
settings_ai_intro: Connect your own AI agent to Unkai over MCP (Model Context Protocol). Unkai never ships or calls an AI model itself — the local interface below simply lets an agent you already use (and its model) read or act on your mail, contacts, calendar, and Talk rooms. Everything stays on this device until you connect an agent.
settings_ai_master_hint_off: Off — no local MCP endpoint is listening, and nothing is exposed to any agent. Turn on to start a localhost-only server your AI client can connect to.
settings_ai_port_hint: Local TCP port the server listens on (1024–65535). Change it if another app already uses this one; the server restarts automatically.
settings_ai_token_hint: Agents must send this token with every request. It is stored in your OS keychain, never leaves this device, and is not part of settings backups.
settings_ai_token_status_absent: No token yet — connections are rejected until you generate one.
settings_ai_token_regenerate_confirm: Generate a new token? The current token stops working immediately and every connected agent must be updated.
settings_ai_token_revoke_confirm: Revoke the token? Every connected agent is cut off until you generate a new one.
settings_ai_token_secret_note: This token is shown only once. Copy it now — Unkai cannot display it again.
settings_ai_snippet_hint: Paste this into your MCP client's configuration. Replace YOUR_TOKEN with the access token from above.
settings_ai_tools_hint: Each tool can be allowed or blocked individually. Disabled tools are hidden from agents and every call is rejected — read tools are allowed by default, write tools are opt-in.
settings_ai_tools_empty: No tools available in this build yet.
settings_ai_hint_create_draft: Creates drafts only — nothing is sent without you pressing Send.
settings_ai_hint_create_contact: Writes new contacts to your address book.
settings_ai_hint_create_event: Creating an event with attendees makes your server send invitation emails to them.
settings_ai_hint_rsvp_event: Responding to an invitation notifies the organizer by email.
settings_ai_hint_create_talk_room: Guests added to a Talk room receive an invitation link by email.
settings_ai_hint_create_meeting_invite: Creates a Talk room and a calendar event; invitation emails may be sent to attendees. The invite card itself is saved as a draft for your review.
settings_ai_encrypted_label: Expose decrypted content to AI agents
settings_ai_encrypted_hint_off: Off — the content of end-to-end encrypted messages is redacted from every tool response and search snippet.
settings_ai_encrypted_hint_on: On — agents can read the decrypted content of end-to-end encrypted messages. This weakens the protection those messages were sent with.
